description: Real-host acceptance cases. These definitions are executed by tools/host_acceptance scripts and reported with provenance; a case is not PASS because a screenshot exists.

H06-A.title: single-source multi-page 101 OUT
H06-A.data: real_gpu 1x101 job or independently validated equivalent; fixture only if explicitly labelled
steps: open the job in the real ComfyUI host
switch to compare view and return
revisit a page after cache eviction
assertions: page 1 has 50, page 2 has 50, page 3 has 1
cache eviction and revisit still works

H06-B.title: selection on first and third result page survives navigation and freezes into export
steps: select one OUT on page 1 and one on page 3
run FINAL export with per-source review
assertions: frozen members equal the selected output ids
export manifest, DB rows and copied files agree

H06-C.title: real host with 5000-source/10000-OUT fixture
steps: seed an isolated runtime with seed_fixture.py
start the real ComfyUI host against that runtime
navigate to the last source page and jump to a numbered source
open a late source result strip
assertions: no full result read on job open

H06-D.title: network failure and late responses during paging
steps: fail a later page request and retry
delay an old page response, then switch source/job
toggle compare while a page request is in flight
assertions: cursor does not advance on failure
late response does not overwrite the new context

UI02.title: keyboard and focus
assertions: modal close returns focus to a sensible control

UI03.title: reduced motion
assertions: interaction completion does not depend on animation

UI04.title: native file chooser upload
steps: choose files through the browser file chooser
assertions: retry does not duplicate a source

UI05.title: image failure, slow response and browser offline
assertions: unconfirmed operation is not shown as success
no automatic inference or old-intent replay after recovery

UI06.title: freeze, logical removal and append
steps: append draws and return to the original position
assertions: subsequent numbering follows the original rule
